comparison.objective: Use a drift to align a sprung splice plate, place bolts, then replace the drift; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tapered-pin insertion, sprung-hole alignment, bolt placement and tool exchange versus hex-key insertion, collar adjustment and counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Plate aligned, both bolts home and drift returned versus repeated impact performance and locked-setting retention.
comparison.reason: Although both involve tools and alignment, drift-assisted structural assembly is a different tested ability from response-based commissioning. Candidate lacks numeric rebound, overload and drift thresholds.
